insert into basket_match_data_submission_player_stat (submission_id, match_id, season_id, stage_id, team_id, player_id, roster_id, started_flag, minutes_seconds, points, rebounds, offensive_rebounds, defensive_rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, field_goals_made, field_goals_attempted, field_goal_pct, three_points_made, three_points_attempted, three_point_pct, free_throws_made, free_throws_attempted, free_throw_pct, plus_minus, efficiency, sort_no, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values
(#{item.submissionId}, #{item.matchId}, #{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.playerId}, #{item.rosterId}, #{item.startedFlag}, #{item.minutesSeconds}, #{item.points}, #{item.rebounds}, #{item.offensiveRebounds}, #{item.defensiveRebounds}, #{item.assists}, #{item.steals}, #{item.blocks}, #{item.turnovers}, #{item.fouls}, #{item.fieldGoalsMade}, #{item.fieldGoalsAttempted}, #{item.fieldGoalPct}, #{item.threePointsMade}, #{item.threePointsAttempted}, #{item.threePointPct}, #{item.freeThrowsMade}, #{item.freeThrowsAttempted}, #{item.freeThrowPct}, #{item.plusMinus}, #{item.efficiency}, #{item.sortNo}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
mapper.select: select id, submission_id as submissionId, match_id as matchId, season_id as seasonId, stage_id as stageId, team_id as teamId, player_id as playerId, roster_id as rosterId, started_flag as startedFlag, minutes_seconds as minutesSeconds, points, rebounds, offensive_rebounds as offensiveRebounds, defensive_rebounds as defensiveRebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers, fouls, field_goals_made as fieldGoalsMade, field_goals_attempted as fieldGoalsAttempted, field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, three_points_made as threePointsMade, three_points_attempted as threePointsAttempted, three_point_pct as threePointPct, free_throws_made as freeThrowsMade, free_throws_attempted as freeThrowsAttempted, free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, plus_minus as plusMinus, efficiency, sort_no as sortNo, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_match_data_submission_player_stat where submission_id = #{submissionId} and is_delete = 0 order by sort_no, id

select ps.team_id as teamId, t.team_name as teamName, ps.player_id as playerId, ifnull(nullif(p.game_nickname, ''), mp.nickname) as playerName, ps.roster_id as rosterId, ps.started_flag as startedFlag, ps.minutes_seconds as minutesSeconds, ps.points, ps.rebounds, ps.offensive_rebounds as offensiveRebounds, ps.defensive_rebounds as defensiveRebounds, ps.assists, ps.steals, ps.blocks, ps.turnovers, ps.fouls, ps.field_goals_made as fieldGoalsMade, ps.field_goals_attempted as fieldGoalsAttempted, ps.field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, ps.three_points_made as threePointsMade, ps.three_points_attempted as threePointsAttempted, ps.three_point_pct as threePointPct, ps.free_throws_made as freeThrowsMade, ps.free_throws_attempted as freeThrowsAttempted, ps.free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, ps.plus_minus as plusMinus, ps.efficiency from basket_match_data_submission_player_stat ps left join basket_team t on t.id = ps.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = ps.player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where ps.submission_id = #{submissionId} and ps.is_delete = 0 order by ps.sort_no, ps.id
